cd /workspace/project && python3 - <<'PY'
import re
s=open('/tmp/main.js',errors='ignore').read()
i=s.find('captchaHeaders(')
while i!=-1:
    seg=s[i:i+520]
    if '{' in seg and 'return' in seg:
        print(re.sub(r'\s+',' ',seg)); print('-'*70); break
    i=s.find('captchaHeaders(',i+1)
# cari juga nama header captchafox
for kw in ['cf-captcha-response','X-CAPTCHA','g-recaptcha-response','captchaFox','captchafox']:
    for m in list(re.finditer(kw,s))[:2]:
        print(f"[{kw}] {re.sub(r'\\s+',' ',s[max(0,m.start()-180):m.start()+180])}")
